data.title: Bitcoin Funds Took In $2.5 Billion as the 10-Year Yield Hit 5.31%. Is Bitcoin Ignoring the Bond Market?
data.description: Bitcoin just posted its best September in over a decade while government bonds hit yields unseen since 2002, a combination that defies almost every rule of how investors are supposed to behave. Something has to give.
